newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy reserve requirement yield cut - Bank of Italy.
newsitem.headline: Italy reserve requirement yield cut - Bank of Italy.

text.p: The return on Italian bank reserve requirements has been cut to 4.5 percent from a previous 5.5 percent, the Bank of Italy said in a statement on Friday.
"This will help bring money supply growth in line with the five percent limit," the statement said.
It said the cut in the reserve yields would be introduced from the July 15/August 14 period.
The five percent money supply target refers to the fourth quarter of 1997 against the same period in 1996, the Bank of Italy said.
Earlier the central bank announced it was cutting its discount rate to 6.25 percent from a previous 6.75 percent. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
